decision_cruda.rationale: The radio and the CMMS agree on LH-03 at TJ-C590-07: hydraulic failure, repaired on site, estimated 0.25 to 0.5 h (likely 0.4 h). The rules therefore don't call for a confirmation. The loss is small: at 220 m LH-03 mucks about 42x100/(100+0.15x120) = 35.6 t/h, so about 14 t (about 0.4 h) is lost, and the stope still holds 412 t of broken ore. Central's stockpile is 174 t with 4 trucks hauling, so haulage, not mucking, limits Central, and the lost mucking is mostly absorbed. A loan would not pay. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance (6 h from 06:00, available about 12:00), so PM-01 rules it out. Any other loader would have to leave a producing stope or a development heading (DEV-COST-01) and spend the travel time plus the 0.25 h manoeuvre, which is as long as the repair itself. Nothing is stopped, so no reserve can be activated. Decision: no moves, expected gain 0 oz versus doing nothing.

LH-03 is down at C590-07. The radio at 09:30 says it is stopped, and the revised CMMS order OT-5101 says 5-8 h (likely 6 h) because the part is not in stock. That supersedes the 0.4 h estimate in OT-5100, so radio and CMMS agree on status and no confirmation is needed. LH-03 would be back around 15:30 at best, so Central loses it for most of the rest of the shift. Central is truck-limited, though. Trucks: 4 on a cycle of about 0.35 h from mid depth, at 40 t payload and a 0.227 factor, give about 100 t/h. Loaders: LH-01 (LH514, 120 m) gives about 41 t/h and LH-02 (LH514, 80 m) gives about 43 t/h, so about 84 t/h in total. The Central level stockpile holds 170 t. The trucks therefore keep hauling at about 100 t/h, drawing the stockpile down by about 19 t/h, or about 130 t over 7 h. The stockpile does not run out before 17:00, so hauled ounces do not fall. A replacement loader would add no hauled ounces at Central. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 12:00, so it cannot move before then. Taking LH-09 off DS-C564-02 would cost 1.5 oz per hour for nothing. Norte has spare truck capacity, but its only producing stope is N600-08, which LH-05 already works, and the move is a 6 km surface trip, so a loan there is not worth it. Este is truck-limited. Reserve stopes can be activated only with a loader from a stopped stope, and no stope is stopped. Decision: no loans and no reserve activations, so the net gain versus doing nothing is 0 oz.
